content.thinking:
'pairs' still exceeds 64 nodes: 22 p + 20 q + up to 40 conflicts = 82. My `len(nodes) < 40` check counts only conflict nodes as they're appended (nodes starts empty), so up to 40 conflicts + 42 = 82. Let me limit conflicts to 20.

Actually, let me simplify: I'll just reduce conflicts to at most 18 nodes.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && sed -i 's/if rng.random() < 0.12 and len(nodes) < 40:/if rng.random() < 0.12 and len(nodes) < 18:/' planhard.py && for k in pairs; do timeout 600 python3 planhard.py $k 22 20; done
echo "=== verification runs (n<=14, brute force) ==="
for k in setpack pairs ties shared equalbenefit; do timeout 900 python3 planhard.py $k 14 25 verify 3; done
